title: Dead and wounded brought to Gaza City hospital after Jabaliya strike

STORYLINE:
Dead and wounded Palestinians were brought to the hospital in Gaza City after an Israeli airstrike and fire hit the Jabaliya area in northern Gaza on Tuesday.

Seven people were killed in an airstrike in a densely populated market area in the Jabaliya refugee camp in northern Gaza, according to Shifa hospital officials in Gaza City.

Among the fatalities was one woman, they said, adding that five other people were wounded.

The strike hit a police point in the western part of Jabaliya, according to the Hamas-run interior ministry which oversees the Gaza police.

The dead included Colonel Mohamad Marwan Salem, head of the police station in Jabaliya, the ministry said.

Elsewhere, an Israeli airstrike hit a tent sheltering a displaced family in the Qadsiah camp in the Muwasi area, killing a man, according to the Nasser hospital.

Three others were wounded.

When asked about the attacks, the Israeli military said it hit suspected militants in Khan Younis and Jabaliya, without providing evidence.

The Nasser hospital said it also received the body of a child who was shot and killed by Israeli soldiers in the Muwasi area, west of Gaza’s southernmost city of Rafah. 

The circumstances of the shooting were unclear.

Tuesday’s deaths were the latest among Palestinians in Gaza since an October fragile ceasefire deal attempted to halt a more than two-year war between Israel and Hamas.

While the heaviest fighting has subsided since a ceasefire took hold in October, Israeli forces have carried out repeated airstrikes, killing at least 1,110 Palestinians, according to health officials in Gaza.

The health ministry, which is part of the Hamas-led government, maintains detailed casualty records that are seen as generally reliable by U.N. agencies and independent experts.

But it does not give a breakdown of civilians and militants.

Militants have carried out shooting attacks on troops, and Israel says its strikes are in response to that and other violations.

Five Israeli soldiers have been killed since the ceasefire.
